visual_connections.description: Data flows from Expedia Group applications into the initial S3 data ingestion bucket.
Data from S3 is sent to EC2 for custom ETL processing.
Data from S3 is sent to Glue for serverless transformation.
Transformed data from EC2 is written to the S3 (csv) bucket.
Transformed data from Glue is written to the S3 (csv) bucket.
ECS Kafka consumers ingest real-time events and write to Aurora.
Data from Aurora is processed by Lambda.
An arrow curves up from SQS delivering data into Salesforce.
